human_capability_summary.built_to: solve hard-exploration reinforcement-learning problems (Montezuma's Revenge, Pitfall) by keeping an archive of visited states ('cells'), deterministically returning to promising cells, exploring from them, and later robustifying the discovered trajectories into a policy
human_capability_summary.pressure: sparse and deceptive rewards where naive exploration forgets promising states and never returns to them; the environment punishes detachment and derailment
human_capability_summary.success_means: reaching previously unreached game states and scores; in the paper, surpassing the human world record on Montezuma's Revenge and solving all Atari hard-exploration games

known_human_problem_solved: detachment and derailment in exploration: remembering where you have been and going back on purpose
